# Renaissance Advisory Services

> Renaissance Advisory Services (RAS) provides specialized advisory services to affordable housing developers, lenders, credit investors, and syndicators. Drawing on more than 25 years of LIHTC (Low-Income Housing Tax Credit) development experience, RAS helps projects overcome obstacles between allocation and closing, provides owner's representation during construction, and helps owners and lenders navigate end-of-compliance-period exits to maximize residual value.

Based in New Orleans, Louisiana. Office: 2600 Gravier St, 7th Floor, New Orleans, LA 70119.

## Services

- [Development Services](https://renadvise.com/#services): Technical expertise, strategic guidance, pre-development capital, and hands-on development support for affordable housing deals facing rising costs, evolving building standards, and stricter underwriting and insurance requirements.
- [Owner's Representation](https://renadvise.com/#services): Designer and contractor selection, contract negotiation, value engineering, and oversight of construction execution, schedule, and budget, for affordable and market-rate projects.
- [Residual Consultancy](https://renadvise.com/#services): Exit strategies for LIHTC properties approaching the end of their compliance periods, including low residual value, investor capital account repayment requirements, and soft debt that blocks sale or refinancing.

## Selected Work

- Arts Senior Apartments, New Orleans, LA
- Tiger Island Senior Apartments, Morgan City, LA
- Old School Senior Apartments, New Orleans, LA
- Bastion Community, New Orleans, LA
